title: Paul McCartney live: Van Andel Arena, Grand Rapids | 2016
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Van Andel Arena in Grand Rapids, Michigan, USA, on 15 August 2016.

It was the 33rd show of the One On One Tour, which lasted for 77 dates between September and November 2005. This concert was seen by 11,280 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

Ringo Starr performed at the Van Andel Arena on 8 August 2003.
